user.title: Set up Closet Assistant
user.description: Tell Closet Assistant where your weather comes from, how quickly your clothes get dirty and when you do laundry.

data.wears_per_wash: How dirty do your clothes get?
data.layering_threshold: Layer when high minus low is at least (degrees)

data_description.wears_per_wash: Base wears between washes. Sweaters, pants and jackets get a multiple of this; underwear and socks are always 1. You can override any item.
data_description.laundry_time: At this time on laundry days every item is marked clean again.
data_description.temperature_sensitivity: Positive if you run cold (dresses you warmer), negative if you run hot.
data_description.layering_threshold: Big daily swings get a layered outfit you can shed by the afternoon.
data_description.declutter_days: Items not worn in this many days show up under "Haven't worn lately". Coats, shorts and other seasonal pieces always get at least a year. 0 turns it off.
data_description.everyday_dressiness: How dressed-up your daily outfit should be: 1 = loungewear, 5 = casual, 7 = smart casual / office, 10 = interview or church. Later, calendar events can set this per day.

error.no_laundry_day: Pick at least one laundry day.
